wikiGoal: A code wiki for this repository. Be carefull, because i'm using bun as runtime, not nodejs

pages.title: Runtime Architecture (Bun.serve + Elysia API + React frontend + widget plugins). Document how Bun serves the HTML shell, mounts the Elysia API under /api, registers widget backend plugins from src/lib/widgets/index.ts, and how the React frontend groups widgets by size into left/center/right columns. Include the new SSE stream endpoint /api/widget/{name}/events for widgets with update:true. Replace all Prova references with Meteo/Sistema. Update or redraw the request-flow and widget data-fetch mermaid diagrams to include the events route and column layout. Verify repo:// sources against current files.
pages.purpose: Update the end-to-end runtime description for the new column-based widget rendering, the Meteo/Sistema registry, and the SSE events route added by update:true widgets. Replace stale Prova references and diagrams.

pages.title: Meteo Widget (Open-Meteo geocoding + forecast integration). Document the query schema (city), the two-stage backend (geocoding-api.open-meteo.com then api.open-meteo.com), weather code-to-icon mapping, Italian locale output, and the React template. Include a sequence diagram of the backend fetch. Note that it is size:left and uses the default query-driven fetch path (not SSE). Cross-reference /openwiki/concepts/widgets.md and /openwiki/architecture/widget-framework.md.
pages.purpose: Add a dedicated page for the Meteo widget so agents can safely change its Open-Meteo integration, geocoding flow, and weather-code mapping.

pages.title: Sistema Widget (Linux /proc system metrics with SSE updates). Document how the backend reads /proc/stat, /proc/meminfo, /proc/loadavg, and /proc/uptime, uses Bun.spawn for nproc, and derives CPU, memory, load, and uptime metrics. Explain that update:true enables the SSE /events route and 5-second refresh interval. Include a sequence diagram and note Linux-only requirements. Cross-reference /openwiki/concepts/widgets.md and /openwiki/architecture/widget-framework.md.
pages.purpose: Add a dedicated page for the Sistema widget so agents understand its Linux /proc dependencies, Bun.spawn usage, and SSE update mode.
